name: What are the benefits of under-cabinet lighting in a kitchen?
description: Under-cabinet lighting provides task illumination, reduces shadows, highlights backsplashes, and enhances kitchen ambiance.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of under-cabinet lighting in a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under-cabinet lighting offers several benefits. It provides excellent task lighting for food preparation on countertops, reducing shadows cast by overhead fixtures. It also enhances the aesthetic appeal of your kitchen by highlighting backsplashes and creating a warm, inviting ambiance. Modern LED strips are discreet and energy-efficient.
